zh: 新增「启动直达页面」：设置 → 通用里能选打开应用先落到哪一页（课表 / 今日 / 课表管理 / 备忘录 / 我的）。
当前选项就显示在这一行的标题上，点开是单选列表，选完即时保存，下次冷启动直接到位。
出厂默认仍是课表，与旧版行为一致；「恢复默认设置」会把它一起还原。
教务导入的学校仍是 388 所（上一版扩量）。
en: New "Launch page": under Settings → General, pick which tab the app opens on (Schedule / Today / Manage / Memo / Mine).
The current choice is shown as the row title; tapping opens a single-choice list that saves immediately and applies on the next cold start.
The default is still Schedule, matching previous behaviour, and "Reset all settings" restores it.
School presets remain at 388 from the previous release.
